# Jesun Ahmad Ushno

> Jesun Ahmad Ushno is a software engineer who builds AI and data systems, agent fleets and machine learning products. He is the Founder of Immitly and Co-Founder of Brimwood Innovation and Climeam. He holds an MSc in Data Analytics with Distinction from the University of Niagara Falls Canada, has published two peer-reviewed machine learning papers and four sole-author preprints, and is based in Toronto.

Also known as Jesun Ushno. Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Canonical entity: https://jesunahmadushno.com/#person

## Ventures

- Immitly (Founder): Immitly is an immigration guidance platform founded by Jesun Ahmad Ushno.
- Brimwood Innovation (Co-Founder): Brimwood Innovation is a Toronto innovation hub co-founded by Jesun Ahmad Ushno and Adam Sayani.
- Climeam (Co-Founder): Climeam is an AI-native creative studio; Jesun Ahmad Ushno is its Co-Founder and directs its work.
- Founders HQ (Founder): Founders HQ is a founder platform founded by Jesun Ahmad Ushno.
- The InfoSec Tribune (Founder): The InfoSec Tribune is a cybersecurity news company founded by Jesun Ahmad Ushno.
